outfit.name: 垫肩千鸟格吸烟西装与高开衩包臀裙
outfit.prose: A razor-sharp black-and-white houndstooth double-breasted power blazer with defined shoulders, open over a deep emerald silk camisole and a leather pencil skirt with a high side slit. Sheer black over-knee stockings are secured with a buckled leather thigh strap that visibly cinches the voluptuous thigh, finished with stiletto heels.
